concept: Review and integration: sustainable discipline as a lifelong practice, not a short-term push
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across sustaining a habit, balancing rest, and modeling discipline for others — what's your personal throughline?
exercise.practice: Adult writes a short personal statement on what discipline means to them in practice

assessment.success_marker: adult produces a personal statement referencing at least two of the three adult-stage scenarios
